title: Derivation of Work Done by an Ideal Spring from Hooke's Law
starting_principles: Definition of work as 1D spatial integral W = int F(x) dx

ordered_steps.explanation: Express the differential work done by the spring restoring force for infinitesimal displacement dx.
Integrate the differential work expression from initial deformation x_i to final deformation x_f.
Evaluate the definite integral using power rule of calculus.

limiting_cases: When starting from natural length x_i = 0, W_s = -1/2 k x_f^2, which is strictly negative for any extension or compression
When returning to initial state x_f = x_i, W_s = 0, proving conservative character over round trip
claim_traces: HCV1 Ch 8 p. 130; HRW Ch 7 p. 175; UP Ch 6 p. 216
